author: Sega Jenesis
title: Hiring digital artists for Pokémon binder scenes
content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀 I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway! Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚 I’d love to see portfolios, pricing, and availability. Contact by replying to the post.

author: Cassidy Cole
title: Looking for character artists for books
content: Looking for character artists who have openings to do some character art for a few of my published and upcoming books!! (Absolutely no AI) Contact via replies on the post.

author: nrfrh_azn
title: Looking for fantasy illustrator for YA novel
content: 🎨 Calling all fantasy illustrators! I’m looking for an illustrator for my upcoming YA fantasy novel. Think dark academia, ancient magic, mysterious towers and an elegant, atmospheric fantasy aesthetic. ✨ If you create fantasy book covers, I’d love to see your portfolio! Please DM me your artwork, rates and estimated turnaround time. Recommendations are welcome too!

author: Aurora Crate Book Box
title: Looking for artists for book box projects
content: We’re looking for some artists with availability between now and the end of 2026. Self recs welcome, please include price list + some examples. No dms please. Also to clarify, NO AI - human artists only please. Contact by commenting with portfolio, pricing, and examples.

author: Smosko
title: Hiring visual artist for EP cover art
content: Hello! Paid project opportunity for visual artists 👇 I’m looking for a visual artist to create the cover artwork for my very first EP. Looking for: digital illustration inspired by Magritte’s surrealist and dreamlike aesthetic. (A detailed brief will be shared with shortlisted artists.) If you’re interested, feel free to reach out via Instagram DM or email(itssmosko@gmail.com) and share your portfolio so I can have a look at your work.

author: Or Cole
title: Looking for character artist for book (flexible payment)
content: I'm looking for an artists that can do character art for my up coming book. And who's willing to work with me because money is tight. So a lot up front wouldn't work but I can definitely pay you what you're worth. Just not up front. No AI please. I am so fucking serious no AI please! Contact via replies or DMs on the post.

author: Meg Humble
title: Seeking character artists for 2 full body characters under £300
content: I know imma regret this, but I’m looking for character artists who have space in November for 2 full body characters (no background needed) ideally for less than £300 🚫 AI 🚫 DMs Authors please also rec people you have used! 🥰 Contact via comments only (no DMs).

author: Merry Robbins
title: Looking for affordable artist for two characters
content: I’m looking for an affordable artist to draw two characters for me. And absolutely no ai. Drop your work in the comments or dm me. (Replies indicate budget up to 250 USD.)
